## 3、**DC02PE07**实现顺序栈的出栈操作

```c
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status Pop_Sq(SqStack &S, ElemType &e) { 
    // Add your code here
if (S.top==*(S.elem)) {
        return ERROR;

    }

    e=S.elem[S.top-1];
    S.top--;

    return OK;

}
```

## 4、**DC02PE11**构建初始容量和扩容增量分别为size和inc的空顺序栈S

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status InitStack_Sq2(SqStack2 &S, int size, int inc) { 
    // Add your code here
if (size<=0||inc<=0) {
    return ERROR;
}

    S.elem = (ElemType *)malloc(sizeof(ElemType));
    S.top = (ElemType *)malloc( sizeof(ElemType));
    
    S.size=size;
    S.increment=inc;

    return OK;

}
```

## 5、**DC02PE15**实现顺序栈的入栈操作

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status Push_Sq2(SqStack2 &S, ElemType e) { 
    //Add your code here
    if (S.top-S.elem>=S.size) {
        ElemType *p=(ElemType *)realloc(S.elem,(S.size+S.increment)*sizeof(ElemType));
        S.elem=p;
        S.top=S.elem+S.size;
        S.size+=S.increment;
    }
    *S.top=e;
    S.top++;
    return OK;

}
```

## 6、**DC02PE19**借助辅助栈，复制顺序栈S1得到S2

```c
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status CopyStack_Sq(SqStack S1, SqStack &S2) { 
    // Add your code here
    SqStack S;
    InitStack_Sq(S,S1.size,S1.increment);
    InitStack_Sq(S2,S1.size,S1.increment);
    ElemType e=NULL;
    while (!StackEmpty_Sq(S1)) {
       Pop_Sq(S1,e);
        Push_Sq(S,e);
    }

   
    while(!StackEmpty_Sq(S)){
        Pop_Sq(S,e);
        Push_Sq(S2,e);
    }

    DestroyStack_Sq(S);

    return TRUE;

}
```

## 7、**DC02PE20**数制转换：将十进制数转换为指定进制的数

```
#include "allinclude.h"
void Conversion(int N, int rd)
{  // Add your code here
SqStack s;
InitStack_Sq(s,MAXSIZE,INCREMENT);

while (N!=0) {
    int a=N%rd;
    ElemType e=a+'0';
    Push_Sq(s,e);
    N=N/rd;
}

ElemType e;
while (!StackEmpty_Sq(s)) {
    Pop_Sq(s,e);
    printf("%c",e);
}

DestroyStack_Sq(s);

}
```

## 8、**DC02PE21**判断一个括号串中的括号是否匹配

```
#include "allinclude.h"
Status matchBracketSequence(char* exp, int n)
{  // Add your code here
if (n%2==1) {
    return ERROR;
}
SqStack s;
InitStack_Sq(s,MAXSIZE,INCREMENT);

for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    ElemType e=NULL;
    if (exp[i]=='}') {
        Pop_Sq(s,e);
        if (e!='{'||e==NULL) {
            return ERROR;
        }
    }else if (exp[i]==']') {
        Pop_Sq(s,e);
        if (e!='['||e==NULL) {
             return ERROR;
        }
    }else if (exp[i]==')') {
        Pop_Sq(s,e);
        if (e!='('||e==NULL) {
             return ERROR;
        }
    }else {
        Push_Sq(s,exp[i]);
    }

}

        if (!StackEmpty_Sq(s)) {
            return ERROR;
        }
    
DestroyStack_Sq(s);
return OK;
}
```

## 9、**DC02PE23**求循环队列的长度

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int QueueLength_Sq(SqQueue Q) { 
   
    if (Q.rear>Q.front) {
        return Q.rear-Q.front;
    }
    if (Q.rear==Q.front) {
        return 0;
    }
    // printf("%d %d",Q.rear,Q.front);
    return Q.maxSize-abs(Q.rear-Q.front);


}
```

## 10、**DC02PE25**编写入队列和出队列的算法

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status EnCQueue(CTagQueue &Q, ElemType x) { 
    // Add your code here
    if (Q.tag==1) return ERROR;
    if (((Q.rear+2)%MAXQSIZE)==Q.front) {
        Q.tag=1;
    }
    Q.elem[Q.rear]=x;
    Q.rear=(Q.rear+1)%MAXQSIZE;
    return OK;
}

Status DeCQueue(CTagQueue &Q, ElemType &x){
   // Add your code here
   if (Q.front==Q.rear&&Q.tag==0) return ERROR;
   if (((Q.front+1)%MAXQSIZE)==Q.rear) {
        Q.tag=0;
   }
   x=Q.elem[Q.front];
   Q.front=(Q.front+1)%MAXQSIZE;
   return OK;

}
```

## 11、**DC02PE27**写出循环队列的入队列和出队列的算法

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status EnCQueue(CLenQueue &Q, ElemType x) { 
    // Add your code here

    if (Q.length==MAXQSIZE) {
        return ERROR;
    }
    Q.elem[(Q.rear+1)%MAXQSIZE]=x;
    Q.length++;
    Q.rear=(Q.rear+1)%MAXQSIZE;
    return OK;
}

Status DeCQueue(CLenQueue &Q, ElemType &x){
    // Add your code here
    if (Q.length==0) {
        return ERROR;
    }
   x=Q.elem[(Q.rear-Q.length+MAXQSIZE+1)%MAXQSIZE];
   Q.length--;
   return OK;
  

}
```

## 12、**DC02PE33**比较两个有序顺序表的大小

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
char Compare(SqList A, SqList B) 
{ // Add your code here
int len=A.length>B.length?B.length:A.length;
    for (int i = 0; i <len ; i++) {
            if (A.elem[i]>B.elem[i]) {
                return '>';
            }else if (A.elem[i]<B.elem[i]) {
                return '<';
            }
    }
    if (A.length>B.length) {
        return '>';
    }else if (A.length<B.length) {
        return '<';
    }else {
        return '=';
    }
}
```

## 13、**DC02PE35**试写一算法，实现顺序表的就地逆置

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void Inverse(SqList &L) 
{ // Add your code here
int n=L.length;
    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; i++) {
        int temp=L.elem[i];
        L.elem[i]=L.elem[n-i-1];
        L.elem[n-i-1]=temp;
    }
   
 
}
```

## 14、**DC02PE45**试写一算法，求并集A＝A∪B。

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void Union(SqList &La, List Lb)
{     // Add your code here
    for (int i = 0; i < Lb.length; i++) {
        ElemType e=Lb.elem[i];
        int index=Search_Sq(La,e);
        //printf("%d %c",index,e);
        if (index==-1) {   
            if (La.length==La.size) {
                int newSize=La.size+La.increment;
                ElemType *newElem = (ElemType *)realloc(La.elem, newSize * sizeof(ElemType));
                La.size=newSize;
                La.elem=newElem;
            }
            Append_Sq(La,e);
            
        }
    }

}
```

## 16、**DC02PE68**编写队列初始化、入队列和出队列的算法

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status InitCLQueue(CLQueue &rear) 
{   // Add your code here
 CLQueue p=(CLQueue)malloc(sizeof(CLQueue));
    rear=p;
    rear->next=p;


return OK;
} 

Status EnCLQueue(CLQueue &rear, ElemType x)
{   // Add your code here
    CLQueue p=(CLQueue)malloc(sizeof(CLQueue));
    p->data=x;
    p->next=rear->next;
    rear->next=p;
    rear=p;
    

}

Status DeCLQueue(CLQueue &rear, ElemType &x)
{    // Add your code here
 if (rear->next==rear) {
    return ERROR;
 }
    CLQueue front=rear->next->next;
    x=front->data;

    if (front==rear) {
        rear=rear->next;
        rear->next=rear;
    }else {
        rear->next->next=front->next;
    }

    return OK;

}
```

## 18、**DC02PE75**实现带头结点单链表的清空操作

```
{    // Add your code here
LinkList p,temp;
if (L==NULL) {
    return ERROR;
}
if (L->next==NULL) {
    return OK;
}
p=L->next;
while (p!=NULL) {
    temp=p;
    p=p->next;
    free(temp);
}
L->next=NULL;
return OK;
}
```

## 19、**DC02PE82**在带头结点单链表L的第i个位置插入e

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status Insert_L(LinkList L, int i, ElemType e) 
{   // Add your code here
if (L==NULL||i<=0) {
    return ERROR;
}
LinkList p=L,before;
LinkList s=(LinkList)malloc(sizeof(LinkList));
s->data=e;
int count=-1;
while (p!=NULL) {
    count++;
    if (count==i) {
       before->next=s;
       s->next=p;
       return OK;
    }
    before=p;
    p=p->next;
}
if (count+1==i) {
    before->next=s;
    s->next=NULL;
    return OK;
}

return ERROR;

}
```

## 20、**DC02PE86**将带头结点单链表的第i元素起的所有元素移除，并构成一个带头结点的新链表

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status Split_L(LinkList L, LinkList &Li, int i)
{   // Add your code here
if (i<=0||L==NULL||L->next==NULL) {
    Li=NULL;
    return ERROR;
}
Li=(LinkList)malloc(sizeof(LinkList));
LinkList p=L->next,before=L;
int count=0;
while (p!=NULL) {
    count++;
    if(count==i){
        Li->next=p;
        before->next=NULL;
        return OK;
    }
    before=p;
    p=p->next;
}
free(Li);
Li=NULL;

return ERROR;

}
```

## 21、**DC02PE88**试写一算法，在带头结点单链表删除第i元素起的所有元素

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status Cut_L(LinkList L, int i)
{   // Add your code here
if (i<=0||L==NULL||L->next==NULL) {
    return ERROR;
}

LinkList p=L->next,before=L,temp=NULL;
int count=0;
while (p!=NULL) {
    count++;
    if(count>=i){
        before->next=NULL;
        temp=p;
        p=p->next;
        free(temp);
    }else {
        before=p;
        p=p->next;
    }
    
}
if (count<i) {
    before->next=NULL;
    return ERROR;
}

return OK;

}
```

## 22、**DC02PE93**删除双向链表中的重复结点

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
DuLinkList delDuplicateDuLNodes(DuLinkList L)
{   // Add your code here

if (L==NULL||L->next==NULL) {
    return L;
}

DuLinkList p=L->next,before=L;
char chars[100];
int len=0;

while (p!=NULL) {
    int sign=-1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        if (p->data==chars[i]) {
            p=p->next;
            before->next=p;
            if (p!=NULL) {
                p->prior=before;
            }else {
                return L;
            }
            sign=0;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (sign==-1) {
        chars[len]=p->data;
        len++;
        before=p;
        p=p->next;
    }
}
return L;



}
```

## 23、**DC02PE94**将一条双向链表逆置

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void reverseDuLinkList(DuLinkList L)
{   // Add your code here

if (L==NULL||L->next==NULL) {
    return ;
}

DuLinkList p=L->next,before=L,temp=NULL;
int count=1;

while (p!=NULL) {
    before->prior=p;
    temp=p->next;
    p->next=before;
    before=p;
    p=temp;
    count++;
}

    before->prior=L;
    temp=L->prior;
    temp->next=NULL;
    L->next=before;
    L->prior=NULL;

}
```

## 24、**DC02PE97**双向交错遍历一条双向循环链表

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void InterleavedTravelDuCirLinkList(DuCirLinkList L, DuLNode* p)
{   // Add your code here
if (L==NULL||L->next==NULL||p==NULL) {
    return;
}
DuLNode *left = p->prior;   
DuLNode *right = p->next;   
DuLNode *temp = L->next; 
int len=0;

while (temp!=L) {
    len++;
    temp=temp->next;
    
}
// printf("%d",len);
if (p==L) {
    len++;
}
for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
    if (i%2==1) {
        //右
        if (right==L) {
            right=right->next;
        }
        printf("%c",right->data);
        right=right->next;
    }else {
        //左
        if (left==L) {
            left=left->prior;
        }
        printf("%c",left->data);
        left=left->prior;
    }
}
if(p!=L) printf("%c",p->data);
}
```

## 25、**DC02PE98**判断一条类似链表的结构是否为合法的双向循环链表

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
Status isLeagalDuCirLinkList(DuCirLinkList L)
{   // Add your code here
if (L==NULL) {
    return TRUE;
}
if (L->next==NULL) {
    return FALSE;
}


int len=0;

DuCirLinkList p=L->next;
DuCirLinkList before=L;

while (p!=L) {

    if (p==NULL||p->prior!=before) {
        return FALSE;
    }

     if (before==NULL||before->next!=p) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    before=p;
    p=p->next;
}

if (p->prior!=before) {
        return FALSE;
    }

     if (before->next!=p) {
        return FALSE;
    }

return TRUE;

}
```
